items.title: Holman Bill — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I mentioned that that movie date with Mandel was a lot of fun.

ctx.x: Ray Sims on trombone, Herb Geller, Charlie Mariano, Richie, Charlie Kennedy, Bill Hood baritone, Victor Feldman, Buddy Clark, Mel Lewis.
Yeah. Talk about an all-star band. That was fun too. I mentioned that that movie date with Mandel was a lot of fun. This was fun too, just to hear those guys play.
You had three consecutive days in the studio. So that‟s great to have three days, back-to-back, to work on the material. Where did the title come from, In a Jazz Orbit?

items.title: Mandel Johnny — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: That’s right; Bill was with us at the same time.

ctx.x: Apparently he brought Holman east to work in New York…
That’s right; Bill was with us at the same time.
So you just did those three charts then? You didn’t do anything else?
